description: This source file generates benchmark statistics for various key types and distributions, specifically for internal hash set probe length analysis in the Abseil library. It includes code for benchmarking different key distributions, custom allocators, and hash policies, and outputs results in either human-readable or JSON format.

classes.name: Policy
classes.description: Defines hash table policies including construction, destruction, and element access.

classes.name: RandomizedAllocator
classes.description: A custom allocator that pools allocations and provides randomized address distribution.

classes.name: DefaultHash
classes.description: Default hash functions for various key types.

classes.name: Table
classes.description: A hash set implementation using the custom policies and allocator.

classes.name: LoadSizes
classes.description: Stores minimum and maximum load sizes for hash table benchmarking.

classes.name: Ratios
classes.description: Holds min, average, and max probe length ratios.

classes.name: Result
classes.description: Stores benchmarking results including name, distribution, and ratios.

classes.name: Sequential
classes.description: Generates sequential key values for benchmarking.

classes.name: AlmostSequential
classes.description: Generates mostly sequential keys with some randomness.

classes.name: Random
classes.description: Generates random key values based on specified distributions.

methods.name: GlobalBitGen
methods.description: Returns a singleton instance of the global random generator.

methods.name: GetMinMaxLoadSizes
methods.description: Calculates min and max load sizes for hash table benchmarking.

methods.name: CollectMeanProbeLengths
methods.description: Collects probe length statistics for hash table keys.

methods.name: CanRunBenchmark
methods.description: Determines if a benchmark should run based on regex filter.

methods.name: RunForTypeAndDistribution
methods.description: Runs benchmarks for specific key types and distributions.

methods.name: RunForType
methods.description: Runs benchmarks for a specific key type across multiple distributions.
